mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO rises > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% year-over-year, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points, the combined signal indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when HOUST declines > 10% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% over three months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months.
